Live session retest from `Hirestepx Bugs (2).pdf` — Senior Product Designer at Pine Labs. Google band ₹28.9–31.9 LPA; session AI quotes ₹33 (within the 5% above-max tolerance, so above-max-stretch does not fire — flagged only in commit notes as a design-band soft-violation). Three behavior bugs pinned here:
  • T3 breakdown-deflection: candidate asks 'I would like to know a breakdown of ₹33 LPA CTC', AI lists categories (base, variable, joining, PF) but no numbers, treating the breakdown ask as a menu choice. wantsBreakdown=true never fired so the server template did not engage.
  • T4 breakdown-deflection + duplicate-reply: candidate restates 'Breakdown of all the parts', AI emits the EXACT same reply as T3 — the duplicate-reply detector catches the verbatim loop (repeated-question only covers a fixed probe-signature list, not arbitrary verbatim duplicates).
  • T5 trailing-closing-question + notice-period-reask: closing outro ends with a question, AND re-asks notice period despite T2 candidate already saying 'Join in thirty days itself'.
